approach: Original MIST adaptation of stable oval-eye identity and event-directed reactions from the studio-published follower clip. A targeted edit establishes tall filled cyan ovals with dark vertical pupils.
limitations: Static pose adaptation only. Continuous source motion was not verified, and the source clip is studio-published rather than verified gameplay. The tall cyan apertures and dark pupils are our original inversion of the studied oval-eye design. No specific animator attribution.

approach: Original face-only inference from Webbed's targeted greeting and raised-limb dance: broad social gaze, eye lift/compression and a reserved success response.
limitations: Original face-only inference from a body-led source. Face gaze substitutes for social orientation and limb acting. Welcome is quite cheerful and amused mouth fairly broad. No timing or continuous motion claim.

approach: Original face-acting experiment from a posture-led source: reduce detail and replace lean, compression and recovery with bold eye silhouettes and a quiet mouth. A targeted edit removes hollow eyes and establishes simple solid apertures.
limitations: Original face-only experiment from a posture-led source whose inspected pose had no visible mouth. Solid cyan eye apertures and all five mouth poses are authored MIST adaptations. No continuous motion claim.

approach: Original frozen-pose inference from large-head follow-through: broad MIST eyes with purposeful gaze offset and unequal settling, readable before adding motion. A targeted edit establishes broad horizontal eyes with clean dark gaze cutouts.
limitations: Original frozen face-pose inference from head lag and large-head acting. Static eye offset cannot validate follow-through timing. Welcome reads quiet and neutral; amused mouth supplies much of the warmth.

approach: Original MIST process study using rough-pose clarity, independent eye/mouth arrival and simple puppet-like holds; expressive mouth contrast without copying the cutscene characters.
limitations: Original process-led static pose experiment. Independent eye/mouth arrival and overshoot are proposed design ideas, not validated animation timing. Welcome reads attentive but somewhat neutral.
